projects.name: 3look
projects.description:
3look is an AI-based application that allows users to create and publish content for social networks, mainly memes and GIF images, with the ability to publish directly to platforms like X (formerly Twitter) for results-based rewards.

It represents a content creator studio where users generate branded or custom content using AI tools for rapid idea generation, face replacement for NFTs or crypto assets, and publishing, while the AI evaluation system transparently assesses impact, distributing revenue without the need for constant interaction.

Designed as a SocialFi project on ApeChain within the ApeCoin ecosystem, it transforms user-created content into reward-generating blockchain assets, with partnerships expanding to networks like Ice Open Network for decentralized social layers.

projects.name: 42 (prev. Alkimiya)
projects.description: 42 is a protocol designed for the creation, trading, and settlement of synthetic resources of the blockchain space using peer-to-peer smart contracts. Public blockchains have limited capabilities for conducting transactions, leading to competition and fee fluctuations. 42 solves this problem by converting key blockchain resources, such as average transaction fee, into tradeable assets, enabling better pricing and resource allocation. This system benefits various users: miners can secure future income by selling transaction fees, service providers such as wallets and exchanges can hedge against fee volatility by purchasing them, and fillers can compensate for high mining costs. The protocol design improves forecasting and management of settlement costs in the network, changing the approach of blockchain networks to resource allocation and pricing.
